projects.title: ReelCast (Senior Project)
projects.description: An ongoing full-stack AI reel generation platform with a video pipeline powered by Google Gemini and fal.ai.
features: Developed a full-stack AI reel generation platform featuring a video pipeline powered by Google Gemini and fal.ai.
Implemented secure authentication (OAuth, 2FA) and comprehensive workflows with Cloudflare R2 storage and end-to-end testing (Playwright, Pytest).

projects.title: Binner (CMU Smart Waste Management App)
projects.description: A cross-platform mobile app that helps users navigate to nearby trash and recycling bins.
features: Developed a cross-platform Flutter app integrated with Google Maps and GPS to help users navigate to nearby trash and recycling bins.
Built a Supabase backend for real-time data, secure authentication, and community-submitted bin locations to encourage proper waste separation.

projects.title: Real or Fa-Ke (Anti Fake News System)
projects.description: A full-stack platform for managing articles and user interactions.
features: Developed a full-stack platform using a Java Spring Boot/MySQL backend and a type-safe Vue 3/TypeScript frontend for managing articles and user interactions.
Implemented hybrid authentication (JWT, Google OAuth2) and integrated Google Cloud SDK for optimized object storage.

projects.title: CJ StreetWear (Streetwear E-commerce Platform)
projects.description: A full-stack e-commerce platform with customer shopping flows and an admin back-office.
features: Developed a full-stack e-commerce platform (Node.js, Express, MySQL) featuring comprehensive customer shopping flows and an admin back-office.
Containerized the entire application, admin panel, and database using Docker Compose for consistent deployment.

projects.title: Asteroid Game (2D Game)
projects.description: A 2D space shooter game built with Java and JavaFX.
features: Developed a 2D space shooter game using Java and JavaFX, implementing core mechanics like collision detection and projectile physics.
Integrated sprite animations and ensured system reliability through extensive JUnit testing.

images.alt: Image Crop and Edge Detector Program

projects.title: Image Crop & Edge Detector Program
projects.description: A Java-based image processing application for automatic image cropping and edge detection.
features: Automatic image cropping with intelligent boundary detection.
Advanced edge detection using Canny and Sobel algorithms.
Real-time image preview and processing with customizable detection parameters.
